whenToUse: Short sequences such as onboarding or carousels.
You show the total and the current position together.
Dots can be pressed to jump straight to a page.
whenNotToUse: There are many pages (use numbers such as "3 / 12").
Moving between pages of a list (use pagination).

alternatives.name: Pagination
alternatives.reason: Moving between pages of a list.

accessibility: When pressable, dots are buttons named "2 of 4" and the current one has aria-current.
When not pressable, the position is given in visually hidden text.
The current dot also differs in length, not color alone.
The pressable area is larger than the dot.
